name: Replication fork DNA synthesis and error-prone translesion bypass
rationale: All members are PCNA-loaded DNA synthesis steps at the fork (priming, elongation, polymerase switching, flap removal) or error-prone TLS, which separates it from base-excision/NER gap filling, error-free POLH TLS and telomere C-strand synthesis in the confusables.

core: Notch signal transmission to the nucleus
qualifier: across NOTCH1-4 paralogs and target transcription
name: Notch1-4 signal transmission to nucleus and target transcription
rationale: Members cover activation and nuclear signalling of NOTCH1 (including HD and translocation mutants), NOTCH2, NOTCH3 and NOTCH4 plus HLH target transcription, unlike confusables centred on NOTCH1 PEST/FBXW7 lesions or Notch roles in Th2 and pancreatic development.

core: Erythroid commitment of hematopoietic stem cells
name: Hematopoietic stem cell commitment to primitive and definitive erythropoiesis
rationale: Members concern erythrocyte differentiation (primitive, definitive, its promotion) and restraint of HSC differentiation in hemopoiesis, whereas confusables address HSC self-renewal/homeostasis or heme and late red-cell maturation.

core: Cholesterol catabolism to bile acids via oxysterols
qualifier: with vitamin E handling and spastic paraplegia genes
name: Oxysterol bile acid synthesis, vitamin E handling, spastic paraplegia genes
rationale: Members are oxysterol-route bile acid synthesis and its CYP7B1/CYP27A1/CYP2U1/SLC33A1 disease defects plus vitamin E metabolism and transport, which no confusable (cholesterol synthesis, bile acid transport/signalling, fatty acid oxidation) contains.

name: Postsynapse assembly, maturation and positive structural plasticity
rationale: All members build or strengthen the postsynapse (spine morphogenesis, PSD maintenance, receptor transport, local translation, maturation), distinguishing it from confusables on LTP/LTD calcium, dendrite arborization or negative spine regulation.

core: Amyloid-beta and APP processing and clearance
name: Amyloid-beta and APP handling with glial activation control
rationale: Most members regulate amyloid-beta formation, fibrillization, clearance and APP metabolism together with astrocyte/microglial activation and tangle assembly, unlike confusables about microglial differentiation, cytotoxicity or lipoprotein signalling.

name: Mullerian duct derivatives and genitalia development
rationale: Members are development of oviduct, uterus, vagina and male/female genitalia, distinct from confusables on gonad/testis differentiation, nephric duct and ureteric bud, or prostate.

name: Cadherin adhesion regulation during epithelial-mesenchymal transition and delamination
rationale: Members regulate cadherin and adherens junction adhesion together with EMT, delamination and Rho-limiting invasion control, whereas confusables concern apical junction assembly, polarity or CDH gene transcription.

name: PINK1-Parkin damaged-mitochondrion response and fission-fusion control
rationale: Members cover depolarisation-triggered PINK1-Parkin mitophagy, Parkin autoubiquitination, membrane potential, fission/fusion and protein retention at mitochondria, unlike confusables on mitochondrial import, receptor-mediated mitophagy or aggrephagy.

qualifier: FGFR1 and FGFR4 via FRS2 and SHC
name: FGFR1 and FGFR4 FRS2/SHC adaptor signaling to MAPK
rationale: Members are FRS- and SHC-mediated MAPK cascades of FGFR1 and FGFR4 with betaKlotho co-receptor binding, separating it from FGFR2/FGFR3 cascades and PLC or PI3K branches in the confusables.

qualifier: IL-3/5/9 and FLT3 with CBL attenuation
name: IL-3/5/9 and FLT3 receptor signaling to STAT5, CBL-attenuated
rationale: Members are IL-3, IL-5, IL-7, IL-9 and FLT3 receptor signalling to SHC/STAT5 and its CBL-mediated shutoff, distinct from confusables built on IL-2/IL-7 STAT5, erythropoietin/thrombopoietin or FLT3/FGFR1 fusion signalling.

name: Mitochondrial transcription and mitoribosome quality control
rationale: Members are mitochondrial transcription initiation, termination and regulation plus mitoribosome-associated quality control, while confusables cover mtDNA replication, mitochondrial RNA processing/stability or translation.

name: FOXO-driven and ligand-withdrawal neuronal apoptosis signaling
rationale: Members centre on pro-death FOXO transcription, ligand-absence extrinsic apoptosis, neuron apoptosis and CDK5 neurodegeneration, unlike confusables on AKT/acetylation control of FOXO, heat shock, or specific dependence receptors.

qualifier: tRNA charging, anticodon modification and translation factor modification
name: tRNA charging, anticodon modification and translation factor modification
rationale: Members are tRNA aminoacylation, anticodon-loop modifications (wybutosine, t6A, wobble), translation termination/readthrough and hydroxylation/hypusine/diphthamide modification of translation factors, distinct from confusables on rRNA, mitochondrial RNA or tRNA processing.

qualifier: with restraint of Th2 cytokine output
name: Eosinophil development, activation and migration with Th2 restraint
rationale: Members are eosinophil and mast cell differentiation, IL-5 signalling, eosinophil activation and chemotaxis plus negative regulation of IL-4/IL-5/Th2, whereas confusables are dominated by positive Th2, IL-13 and IL-33 programmes.

name: Non-histone lysine and arginine methylation with methionine-sensed translation initiation
rationale: Members are protein lysine/arginine methylation (including TP53) and methionine-responsive cap-dependent translation and ribosome biogenesis, unlike confusables on histone/chromatin modifier complexes, Pol I/III transcription or protein hydroxylation.

name: Forebrain patterning and tangential interneuron migration
rationale: Members are cortical/olfactory interneuron tangential migration, cortex regionalization, thalamus and pyramidal neuron development, distinct from confusables on cerebellar, hindbrain, retinal or radial migration processes.

qualifier: regulation of glucocorticoid and aldosterone synthesis and secretion
name: Regulation of glucocorticoid and aldosterone synthesis and secretion
rationale: Members regulate cortisol, corticosterone and aldosterone biosynthesis and secretion including ACTH drive and glucocorticoid response, distinct from confusables on stress behaviour, thyroid hormone or core steroidogenic enzyme reactions.

core: IL-1 family cytokine processing and signaling
name: IL-1 family cytokine processing and signaling with IL-17 axis
rationale: Members are IL-1/IL-18/IL-36/IL-38 precursor processing and signalling plus IL-17 production, signalling and Th17 commitment, unlike confusables on IL-10/IL-12/IL-23 families, C-type lectin or inflammasome assembly.

name: IL-6-family gp130 cytokine signaling through STAT3 and ERK
rationale: Members are IL-6, IL-11, LIF, CNTF and oncostatin M signalling with STAT3 and ERK1/2 activation and its negative regulation, distinct from confusables on IL-10/IL-27/IL-35, IFN-gamma or common-gamma-chain cytokines.

qualifier: proteasomal and endosomal routes to MHC I/II in APCs
name: Proteasomal and endosomal antigen processing for MHC I/II presentation
rationale: Members cover proteasome assembly, MHC I/II peptide loading, cross-presentation, viral MHC/CD4 downregulation and antigen-presenting cell signatures, unlike confusables on NK/T cytotoxicity, PD-L1 regulation or NKT activation.

name: snRNA transcription, snRNP biogenesis and histone mRNA 3'-end processing
rationale: Members are Pol II/III snRNA transcription, cap hypermethylation, transport and snRNP assembly plus SLBP/stem-loop histone pre-mRNA processing, distinct from confusables on spliceosome catalysis, splicing regulation or polyadenylation.

qualifier: ganglioside degradation and its storage disorders
name: Lysosomal ganglioside and glycosphingolipid catabolism and storage disorders
rationale: Members are lysosomal ganglioside/glycosphingolipid breakdown and HEXA, HEXB and NEU1 deficiencies, unlike confusables on glycosaminoglycan degradation/mucopolysaccharidoses or sialic acid and amino sugar metabolism.

name: Cardiac rate and contractility control via sarcoplasmic calcium release
rationale: Members regulate heart rate, contraction force and relaxation through cardiomyocyte membrane potential and release of sequestered calcium, distinct from confusables on SERCA calcium uptake, skeletal muscle RyR or fibre-type transition.

qualifier: renal vesicle through S-shaped body tubules
name: Nephron epithelialization from renal vesicle through S-shaped body
rationale: Members are mesenchymal-to-epithelial transition, renal vesicle, comma- and S-shaped body and tubule epithelial formation, unlike confusables on nephron segment patterning, mesenchymal progenitor maintenance or ureteric bud elongation.
